question: Is the successful non-Pages check set sufficient to accept the `actions/setup-node@v7` major upgrade in the Pages workflow?
rationale: The patch is mechanically correct, but accepting a major action-runtime change without executing the affected publication job is an ownership decision rather than a code defect.

options.title: Validate Pages exact head
options.body: Run or inspect the Pages workflow at commit `3d9360ba08a3fba8ca5f628766b34c413a8148fe` before merging.

options.title: Accept upstream compatibility
options.body: Merge the minimal update based on the official setup-node release and the successful unaffected checks.

recommendation.title: Validate Pages exact head
recommendation.body: Run or inspect the Pages workflow at commit `3d9360ba08a3fba8ca5f628766b34c413a8148fe` before merging.
